content.comment_body: I was previously able to add a table without issue, but now I cannot add to the global tag table. The plus icon is unresponsive. Any suggestions?
Could you clarify which "plus sign" you're referring to? Please provide additional details, such as a screenshot.
After closing and restarting [product_name], I was able to edit the global tag table again. It appears to have been an issue with my computer. Everything works now, thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: The primary concern was difficulty adding entries to the global tag table, as the interface element did not respond. Restarting the software resolved the issue, suggesting it was related to the user's PC rather than a software defect. The interaction points to a temporary disruption in software usability, likely caused by application or system instability.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects reliable software interface behavior and uninterrupted ability to edit the global tag table.
